definition_zh: 考虑；需要考虑的因素；体谅
definition_en: the act of thinking carefully about something, or a fact that must be weighed
core_image: 桌上摊着几张纸，一个人托着下巴逐条权衡
scene: 面试前夜，她把每个条件在纸上排了一遍。After long consideration, she accepted the offer.
sceneCN: 这里 consideration 指「仔细考虑」（第 1 个义项：对某事反复权衡）；句意是经过长时间的考虑，她接受了这份工作。

pos.zh: 考虑；需要考虑的因素；体谅

senses.title: Careful thought
senses.definition: the act of thinking about something carefully before acting
senses.definitionCN: 行动之前对某事反复思考
senses.example: After much consideration, they chose the cheaper plan.
senses.exampleCN: 经过再三考虑，他们选择了更便宜的那个方案。
senses.why: A decision made in a hurry often misses what a slow look would catch.
senses.whyCN: 匆忙作出的决定，常常漏掉慢看时能看见的东西。

senses.title: A fact to weigh
senses.definition: something that must be taken into account when deciding
senses.definitionCN: 做决定时必须纳入权衡的事情
senses.example: Cost is only one consideration here.
senses.exampleCN: 在这里，成本只是需要考虑的一个因素。
senses.why: A good choice needs more than one item on the scale.
senses.whyCN: 好的选择需要天平上不只放一样东西。

senses.title: Thought for others
senses.definition: kind attention to the feelings of other people
senses.definitionCN: 对他人感受的体贴照顾
senses.example: He showed no consideration for the tired staff.
senses.exampleCN: 他对疲惫的员工毫不体谅。
senses.why: The same mind that weighs facts can also weigh feelings.
senses.whyCN: 权衡事实的那颗心，也能权衡别人的感受。

intro.en: Consideration comes from Latin considerare, to look at closely, a word once linked to sidus, a star, as if reading the sky.
intro.cn: consideration 来自拉丁语 considerare，意为仔细察看，旧说与 sidus（星星）有关，仿佛观星以定吉凶。

items.en: Sidus meant star, and considerare may once have meant to observe the stars.
items.cn: sidus 意为星星，considerare 最初可能指观察星象。

items.en: Considerare widened to mean examining anything with care.
items.cn: considerare 的词义扩大为仔细察看任何事物。

items.en: The noun consideratio named the act of careful looking.
items.cn: 名词 consideratio 指仔细察看这一行为。

items.en: French consideration carried the sense of respectful regard.
items.cn: 法语 consideration 带有尊重与顾念的含义。

items.en: English consideration first meant careful thought before a choice.
items.cn: 英语 consideration 最初指做选择前的仔细思考。

items.en: It now also names a single fact that must be weighed.
items.cn: 如今它也指必须纳入权衡的某一因素。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words from the same consider- family, and the meaning group names other kinds of careful thought.
note.cn: 形近组收的是同一个 consider- 词族的词，近义组列出其他表示仔细思量的说法。

entries.definition: thinking about the feelings of other people
large enough to be important
used to say that something is true when you think of the facts
the activity of thinking, or an idea produced by it
long and careful discussion before a decision
attention or care given to someone

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a slow look at the facts, then move to the single fact that tips a choice and to care for other people.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从慢慢端详事实开始，再到压动选择的那一个因素，最后落到对他人的体谅。

normal.en: Con- is together and sider is star, so consideration is reading the sky before you move.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sider 是星星，consideration 就是先看星象再行动。

normal.en: A table with three papers on it: that is consideration at work.
normal.cn: 桌上摊着三张纸，这就是考虑正在进行的样子。

normal.en: One factor is not a decision, so consideration puts several on the scale.
normal.cn: 一个因素不成决定，所以考虑要把好几样放上天平。

normal.en: Consideration for others is the same word turned toward feelings.
normal.cn: 体谅不过是同一个词转向了感受这一边。

normal.en: Look twice, then act once.
normal.cn: 看两遍，再动手一次。

abstract.en: Picture a hand holding a scale that is still moving.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手扶着一架仍在晃动的天平。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp over a page full of small notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯照着一页密密麻麻的小字。

abstract.en: Picture a chair pulled out for someone who looks tired.
abstract.cn: 想象有人为一位显出疲态的人拉开椅子。

examples.en: After much consideration, she turned down the offer.
examples.cn: 经过反复考虑，她拒绝了那份邀约。

examples.en: Safety must be the first consideration in this design.
examples.cn: 在这个设计里，安全必须是首要的考虑。

examples.en: He treats his staff with real consideration.
examples.cn: 他对员工十分体谅。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consideration 记成 con（一起）加 sider（星星）加 ation：像古人一起看星推演吉凶那样反复权衡，就是考虑。

root: 源自拉丁语 considerare（仔细察看），旧说与 sidus（星星）有关，仿佛观星以定吉凶，后指考虑、需要权衡的因素与体谅。

sensesIntro.en: From slow looking, to the facts that demand a look, and finally to looking after other people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从慢慢察看，到必须察看的事实，最后到照看别人的感受。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scale on a table with papers on both sides.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上放着一架天平，两边都压着纸。

branches.en: Careful thought slows the hand before it moves.
branches.cn: 仔细考虑让手在行动之前先慢下来。

branches.en: A single consideration can change the whole balance.
branches.cn: 一个因素就能改变整个平衡。

branches.en: The same habit of mind turns into kindness toward people.
branches.cn: 同一种思维习惯转向人，就成了体贴。

branches.en: Both senses put something on a scale and wait for it to settle.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是把东西放上天平，等它稳定下来。

branches.en: A person can be the factor that a careful mind weighs.
branches.cn: 人本身也可以成为那颗细心的心所权衡的因素。

intro.en: Consideration is built on Latin con-, together, plus considerare, to examine.
intro.cn: consideration 由拉丁语 con-（一起）与 considerare（察看）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin star base sider- also appears in sidereal, while the consider- family runs through consider and considerable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的星词基 sider- 也出现在 sidereal 中，而 consider- 词族贯穿 consider 与 considerable。

items.meaning: the act of weighing something in the mind
items.meaningCN: 在心里权衡某事的行为
items.exampleCN: 这个计划正在考虑之中。

items.meaning: to examine something in the mind
worth noticing because of its size
items.example: The repair cost a considerable sum.
items.exampleCN: 这次修理花了一笔不小的钱。

items.meaning: careful about other people's feelings
items.example: It was considerate of you to call.

items.meaning: in a way that shows care for others
items.example: She spoke considerately to the child.

items.meaning: not thinking about other people
items.example: Loud music at midnight is inconsiderate.
items.exampleCN: 半夜大声放音乐是不替别人着想。

items.meaning: when you take the facts into account
items.example: She did well, considering her age.
items.exampleCN: 考虑到她的年龄，她做得很好。

items.meaning: to think about a choice once more

definition_en: to be made up of particular parts, or to have something as its central point
core_image: 一只碗里盛着几样分辨得清的配料
scene: 厨师示范前先说明汤里放了什么。The soup consists of tomatoes, beans and a little salt.
sceneCN: 这里 consist 指「由…组成」（第 1 个义项：整体由若干部分构成）；句意是这道汤由番茄、豆子和少量盐组成。

senses.title: Made of parts
senses.definition: to be made up of particular parts or elements
senses.definitionCN: 整体由若干具体部分构成
senses.example: The team consists of six engineers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队由六名工程师组成。
senses.why: You cannot name a whole without naming what stands inside it.
senses.whyCN: 要说清一个整体，就得说清里面站着什么。

senses.title: Lying in
senses.definition: to have something as its essential point or quality
senses.definitionCN: 以某事为其根本要点或性质
senses.example: True comfort consists in wanting less.
senses.exampleCN: 真正的自在在于欲求更少。
senses.why: Some things are not built of parts but rest on one idea.
senses.whyCN: 有些事物不是由零件搭成，而是靠一个念头立住。

senses.title: Standing together
senses.definition: to be in agreement with something, an older and rarer sense
senses.definitionCN: 与某事物相符合，是较古老且少用的义项
senses.example: The two reports consist with each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两份报告彼此吻合。
senses.why: Things that stand together also tend to tell the same story.
senses.whyCN: 站在一起的东西，往往也讲着同一个故事。

intro.en: Consist comes from Latin consistere, to stand together, built from com-, together, and sistere, to stand.
intro.cn: consist 来自拉丁语 consistere，意为站在一起，由 com-（一起）与 sistere（站立）构成。

items.en: Sistere meant to stand still or take a stand.
items.cn: sistere 意为站定或站住立场。

items.en: Consistere meant to take a firm position together.
items.cn: consistere 意为一起站定位置。

items.en: Later Latin gave it the sense of being made of parts.
items.cn: 后来的拉丁语赋予它由部分构成的含义。

items.en: French consister narrowed to being composed of something.
items.cn: 法语 consister 收窄为由某物构成。

items.en: English consist kept both the standing and the composed senses.
items.cn: 英语 consist 同时保留了站定与构成两层意思。

items.en: Today the pattern consist of is by far the most common.
items.cn: 今天 consist of 这一搭配最为常用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base sist-, and the meaning group names other ways of saying what a whole is made of.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的站立词基 sist-，近义组列出其他表示整体由何构成的说法。

entries.definition: always behaving or happening in the same way
to say firmly that something must happen
to keep going even when it is hard
to have particular parts as its contents
to make up the parts of a whole
to have something inside

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from parts standing together, then move to the one point a thing rests on and to old agreement.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从各部分站在一起开始，再到一件事所依托的那个要点，最后到古老的相一致义。

normal.en: Con- is together and sist is stand, so consist is parts standing together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sist 是站立，consist 就是各部分站在一起。

normal.en: Take the soup apart in your mind, and you have consist of.
normal.cn: 在心里把那碗汤拆开来看，你就得到了 consist of。

normal.en: Consist of names the parts, while consist in names the point.
normal.cn: consist of 点出部分，consist in 点出要害。

normal.en: A chair consists of legs, a seat and a back, yet you still see one chair.
normal.cn: 椅子由腿、座面和靠背组成，可你看到的仍是一把椅子。

normal.en: Ask what it is made of, then ask what it really rests on.
normal.cn: 先问它由什么做成，再问它究竟靠什么立住。

abstract.en: Picture four stones holding up one flat slab.
abstract.cn: 想象四块石头托起一块平板。

abstract.en: Picture a row of ingredients laid beside a pot.
abstract.cn: 想象一排配料摆在锅边。

abstract.en: Picture a rope made of many thin threads.
abstract.cn: 想象一根由许多细线拧成的绳子。

examples.en: The course consists of ten short lessons.
examples.cn: 这门课由十节短课组成。

examples.en: Happiness does not consist in having more.
examples.cn: 幸福并不在于拥有更多。

examples.en: A good meal consists of simple things done well.
examples.cn: 一顿好饭由几样做得到位的简单食材组成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consist 记成 con（一起）加 sist（站立）：几样东西站在一起构成一个整体，就是由…组成。

root: 源自拉丁语 consistere（com 一起 + sistere 站立），本义是一起站定，后指由若干部分构成、要点在于。

sensesIntro.en: From parts standing together, to the point a thing rests on, and at last to an older sense of agreement.
sensesIntro.cn: 从各部分站在一起，到一件事所依托的要点，最后到较为古老的相一致之义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several stones standing shoulder to shoulder under one slab.
core.cn: 核心意象：几块石头并肩立在同一块石板之下。

branches.en: The commonest sense simply lists what a whole is made of.
branches.cn: 最常用的义项只是列出整体由什么构成。

branches.en: The second sense points to the one idea a thing rests on.
branches.cn: 第二个义项指向一件事所依托的那一个念头。

branches.en: The old sense says two things can stand without contradiction.
branches.cn: 古老义项说的是两件事能并立而不相矛盾。

branches.en: Both senses answer the question of what something really is.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在回答某物究竟是什么。

branches.en: A thing that rests on one point can also agree with another.
branches.cn: 依托于一个要点的事物，也能与另一事物相合。

intro.en: Consist is built on Latin com-, together, plus sistere, to stand.
intro.cn: consist 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 sistere（站立）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base sist- also appears in insist, persist and resist.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 sist- 也出现在 insist、persist 与 resist 中。

items.meaning: to be made of parts standing together
items.meaningCN: 由站在一起的部分构成
items.example: The group consists of five members.
items.exampleCN: 这个小组由五名成员组成。

items.meaning: holding together without change
items.example: Her work is consistent and careful.

items.meaning: in the same way every time
the quality of staying the same
changing in a way that does not fit
to stand firmly on a demand
to keep standing through difficulty
to stand against something
items.example: He could not resist the cake.

definition_zh: 一贯的；前后一致的；与…相符的
definition_en: always behaving or happening in the same way, or in agreement with something
core_image: 一条笔直的刻度线，从头到尾没有偏移
scene: 教练翻看整季的记录，发现队员的状态几乎没有起伏。Her consistent effort finally paid off.
sceneCN: 这里 consistent 指「一贯的」（第 1 个义项：长期保持同样的标准）；句意是她一贯的努力终于有了回报。

pos.zh: 一贯的；前后一致的；与…相符的

senses.title: Staying the same
senses.definition: keeping the same standard or pattern over time
senses.definitionCN: 在时间里保持同样的标准或做法
senses.example: Her grades were consistent all year.
senses.exampleCN: 她全年的成绩一直很稳定。
senses.why: A pattern only becomes visible when it repeats without breaking.
senses.whyCN: 只有不被打断地重复，一种做法才会显出形状。

senses.title: In agreement
senses.definition: matching another fact, rule or account
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事实、规则或说法相吻合
senses.example: His story is consistent with the evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 他的说法与证据相符。
senses.why: Two pieces of a puzzle are trusted when their edges fit.
senses.whyCN: 拼图的两块只有边对得上，才让人相信。

senses.title: Steady in quality
senses.definition: holding the same quality or texture without sudden change
senses.definitionCN: 质地或品质保持不变，没有突然的波动
senses.example: The sauce has a consistent texture.
senses.exampleCN: 这酱汁的质地很均匀。
senses.why: Hands and tongues notice a single lump at once.
senses.whyCN: 手和舌头一下子就能察觉出那一点疙瘩。

intro.en: Consistent comes from Latin consistens, the present participle of consistere, to stand firm together.
intro.cn: consistent 来自拉丁语 consistens，是 consistere（一起站稳）的现在分词。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and sistere meant to take a stand.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，sistere 意为站定。

items.en: Consistere described things holding their place together.
items.cn: consistere 描述事物一起守住各自的位置。

items.en: Consistens named whatever stood firm without shifting.
items.cn: consistens 指稳稳站住、不肯移动的事物。

items.en: French consistant used the word for firm and solid things.
items.cn: 法语 consistant 用它形容坚实不散的东西。

items.en: English consistent moved from physical firmness to steady behaviour.
items.cn: 英语 consistent 从实体的坚固转向行为的稳定。

items.en: It now chiefly means agreeing with itself or with the facts.
items.cn: 如今它主要指与自身或与事实相符。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base, and the meaning group names other words for a pattern that does not break.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的站立词基，近义组列出其他表示「不中断的做法」的词。

entries.definition: to be made up of particular parts
to demand something firmly
to continue in spite of difficulty
developing or moving at an even rate
happening all the time without a pause
the same in all its parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from parts that keep standing in place, then move to two edges that fit and to an even texture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从守在原位的各部分开始，再到对得上的两条边，最后到均匀的质地。

normal.en: Con- is together and sist is stand, so consistent is standing together without slipping.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sist 是站立，consistent 就是一起站住而不滑动。

normal.en: A ruler with no bent mark: that is a consistent record.
normal.cn: 一把没有任何弯折刻度的尺子，就是一贯的记录。

normal.en: Two puzzle edges that fit mean the accounts are consistent.
normal.cn: 两块拼图的边能对上，就说明两种说法彼此相符。

normal.en: Consistent effort is boring to watch and hard to beat.
normal.cn: 一贯的努力看着乏味，却很难被击败。

normal.en: Say the same true thing on a good day and a bad day.
normal.cn: 在顺境和逆境里说同一句真话。

abstract.en: Picture a compass drawing the same circle twice.
abstract.cn: 想象一把圆规把同一个圆画了两遍。

abstract.en: Picture a row of bricks all set at the same height.
abstract.cn: 想象一排砖都砌在同一高度。

abstract.en: Picture a heartbeat line that keeps an even rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象一条保持均匀节奏的心跳线。

examples.en: The team showed consistent improvement over the season.
examples.cn: 这支队伍在整个赛季里稳步提高。

examples.en: Her answer was consistent with the facts.
examples.cn: 她的回答与事实相符。

examples.en: He is consistent in the way he treats people.
examples.cn: 他待人接物的方式始终如一。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consistent 记成 con（一起）加 sist（站立）加 ent：始终站在同一个位置不动，就是一贯的、前后一致的。

root: 源自拉丁语 consistere（com 一起 + sistere 站立）的现在分词 consistens，本义是稳稳站住，后指一贯不变与前后相符。

sensesIntro.en: From a pattern that never shifts, to two accounts that fit, and finally to an even texture you can feel.
sensesIntro.cn: 从从不改变的做法，到彼此吻合的两种说法，最后到手上能摸出的均匀质地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight line of marks with no gap and no tilt.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排笔直的刻度，既不断裂也不倾斜。

branches.en: The first sense is a habit repeated until it looks like a line.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是重复到成一条线的习惯。

branches.en: The second sense judges whether two accounts share an edge.
branches.cn: 第二个义项判断两种说法是否共享同一条边。

branches.en: The third sense is evenness you can feel with hand or tongue.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是手或舌头能感到的均匀。

branches.en: Both senses ask whether something would look the same on a second look.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在问：再看一遍是否还是这个样子。

branches.en: A steady hand and a steady sauce both refuse sudden change.
branches.cn: 稳定的手与均匀的酱汁都拒绝突然的变化。

intro.en: Consistent is built on Latin con-, together, plus sistere, to stand, with the adjective ending -ent.
intro.cn: consistent 由拉丁语 con-（一起）、sistere（站立）与形容词词尾 -ent 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base sist- also appears in insist, persist and resist, and the -ent ending marks a quality.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 sist- 也出现在 insist、persist 与 resist 中，而 -ent 词尾表示一种性质。

items.meaning: standing together in the same way
items.meaningCN: 以同样的方式站在一起

items.meaning: to be made up of parts
items.example: The team consists of four people.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队由四个人组成。

items.meaning: in the same way every time
the state of staying the same
not staying the same or not fitting
to stand firmly on a demand
items.example: They insisted on a written reply.

items.meaning: to keep standing through hardship
to stand against pressure
items.example: She resisted the urge to shout.

definition_en: happening all the time without stopping, or staying the same in value
core_image: 钟摆一刻不停地摆动，幅度始终不变
scene: 夜里水管一直滴水，声音从没停过。The constant dripping kept her awake.
sceneCN: 这里 constant 指「不断的」（第 1 个义项：持续不停发生）；句意是不断的滴水声让她睡不着。

senses.title: Never stopping
senses.definition: happening again and again without a real pause
senses.definitionCN: 反复发生而没有真正的停顿
senses.example: The constant noise made it hard to sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 不断的噪音让人难以入睡。
senses.why: A sound that never stops becomes a presence in the room.
senses.whyCN: 从不停止的声音，会变成房间里的一个存在。

senses.title: Staying the same
senses.definition: remaining at the same level or value
senses.definitionCN: 保持在同一个水平或数值上
senses.example: Keep the oven at a constant heat.
senses.exampleCN: 让烤箱保持恒定的温度。
senses.why: Science needs a number that refuses to move.
senses.whyCN: 科学需要一个不肯移动的数字。

senses.title: Loyal and faithful
senses.definition: remaining loyal to a person over a long time, a literary sense
senses.definitionCN: 长久地忠于某人，是较为书面的义项
senses.example: He remained her constant friend.
senses.exampleCN: 他始终是她忠诚的朋友。
senses.why: A heart that does not shift is also called constant.
senses.whyCN: 一颗不肯改变的心，也被称作忠贞。

intro.en: Constant comes from Latin constans, the present participle of constare, to stand firm, built from com-, together, and stare, to stand.
intro.cn: constant 来自拉丁语 constans，是 constare（站稳）的现在分词，由 com-（一起）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and constare meant to stand firm together.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，constare 意为一起站稳。

items.en: Constans described a thing that kept its place and its nature.
items.cn: constans 描述守住位置与本性的事物。

items.en: Writers used it for people steady in loyalty.
items.cn: 作家用它形容忠诚不移的人。

items.en: French constant kept both the steady and the faithful senses.
items.cn: 法语 constant 同时保留稳定与忠贞两层意思。

items.en: English constant first described firm and unchanging things.
items.cn: 英语 constant 最初形容坚实不变的事物。

items.en: It now also names a fixed number in mathematics.
items.cn: 如今它也是数学里的一个固定数值。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base or the same ending, and the meaning group names other words for something that does not stop.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语站立词基或相同词尾，近义组列出其他表示「不停」的词。

entries.definition: in a way that never really stops
the quality of staying the same
a clear difference between two things
regular and not likely to change
repeated many times over a period
continuing for a long time and hard to stop

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a point that refuses to move, then move to a fixed number and to a heart that stays loyal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一个不肯移动的点开始，再到一个固定的数值，最后到一颗守着忠诚的心。

normal.en: Con- is together and stant is standing, so constant is standing still and refusing to budge.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，stant 是站立，constant 就是站定不动、不肯让步。

normal.en: A clock that ticks every second is constant, not fast.
normal.cn: 每秒滴答一次的钟是恒常，而不是快。

normal.en: Constant heat keeps a cake rising evenly.
normal.cn: 恒定的温度让蛋糕均匀地涨起来。

normal.en: The same friend in every season is a constant friend.
normal.cn: 每个季节都在的朋友，才是忠诚的朋友。

normal.en: What never pauses becomes part of the background.
normal.cn: 从不停下的东西，会变成背景的一部分。

abstract.en: Picture a pendulum swinging with the same width forever.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟摆永远以同样的幅度摆动。

abstract.en: Picture a straight line across a graph with no slope.
abstract.cn: 想象图上一条毫无倾斜的直线。

abstract.en: Picture one lamp left on in a window all night.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇窗里整夜亮着的一盏灯。

examples.en: The constant rain ruined the whole trip.
examples.cn: 不停的下雨毁了整个行程。

examples.en: Keep the room at a constant temperature.
examples.cn: 让房间保持在恒定的温度。

examples.en: She was a constant source of support.
examples.cn: 她始终是支持的来源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constant 记成 con（一起）加 stant（站立）：始终站在原地不动，就是恒定的、不间断的。

root: 源自拉丁语 constare（com 一起 + stare 站立），本义是一起站稳，后指持续不断、数值恒定与忠诚不渝。

sensesIntro.en: From a sound with no pause, to a number that will not move, and finally to a heart that stays true.
sensesIntro.cn: 从毫无停顿的声音，到不肯移动的数字，最后到一颗始终如一的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pendulum with the same swing, again and again.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只以同样幅度一遍遍摆动的钟摆。

branches.en: The first sense is repetition so regular that it becomes background.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是规律到成为背景的重复。

branches.en: The second sense is a value that refuses to drift.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一个拒绝漂移的数值。

branches.en: The third sense moves the same steadiness into loyalty.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同样的稳定移到忠诚上。

branches.en: Both senses describe something you can measure and predict.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述可以测量和预测的事物。

branches.en: A constant number and a constant friend both keep their word.
branches.cn: 恒定的数值与忠诚的朋友都守着自己的承诺。

intro.en: Constant is built on Latin con-, together, plus stare, to stand, with the adjective ending -ant.
intro.cn: constant 由拉丁语 con-（一起）、stare（站立）与形容词词尾 -ant 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base stat- also appears in statue, stable and station.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 stat- 也出现在 statue、stable 与 station 中。

items.meaning: standing firm without change
without stopping or very often
the quality of staying the same
items.exampleCN: 她的坚贞让所有人惊讶。

items.meaning: changing too easily
a figure made to stand still
items.example: A bronze statue stood in the square.

items.meaning: able to stand without falling
to hold a position firmly
to stand against a force

definition_en: in a way that keeps happening without a real break
core_image: 秒针一圈圈走过，从不停下
scene: 她一边打电话，一边在门口来回走动。He is constantly checking whether the door is locked.
sceneCN: 这里 constantly 指「不断地」（第 1 个义项：反复而不停歇）；句意是他不停地确认门有没有锁好。

senses.title: Without stopping
senses.definition: continuing without any real break
senses.definitionCN: 持续进行而几乎没有间断
senses.example: The machine runs constantly all night.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器整夜不停地运转。
senses.why: Some processes only stop when the power does.
senses.whyCN: 有些过程只在断电时才停下。

senses.title: Again and again
senses.definition: repeating so often that it starts to annoy
senses.definitionCN: 重复得太多，已经开始惹人烦
senses.example: He constantly interrupts me.
senses.exampleCN: 他一再打断我。
senses.why: A habit repeated too often turns into noise.
senses.whyCN: 重复太多的习惯，会变成噪音。

senses.title: All the while
senses.definition: during the whole of a period, without a gap
senses.definitionCN: 在整个一段时间里，没有间断
senses.example: She was constantly aware of the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 她始终留意着那只钟。
senses.why: A quiet state can last as long as the day does.
senses.whyCN: 一种安静的状态，可以和一天一样长。

intro.en: Constantly is constant plus -ly, from Latin constans, standing firm, which comes from constare, to stand together.
intro.cn: constantly 是 constant 加 -ly，源自拉丁语 constans（稳稳站住），其词根是 constare（一起站立）。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and constare meant to stand firm.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，constare 意为站稳。

items.en: Constans described what kept its place and nature.
items.cn: constans 描述守住位置与本性的事物。

items.en: French constant passed the steady sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 constant 把稳定的含义带进英语。

items.en: The adverb constantli first meant in a steady manner.
items.cn: 副词形式最初指以稳定的方式。

items.en: It widened to mean again and again over time.
items.cn: 它的词义扩大为在时间中反复发生。

items.en: Today it often carries a hint of complaint.
items.cn: 今天它常带一点抱怨的意味。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the constant- family or the -antly ending, and the meaning group names other words for repeated action.
note.cn: 形近组共享 constant- 词族或 -antly 词尾，近义组列出其他表示反复动作的词。

entries.definition: happening all the time without a pause
the quality of staying the same
at once, with no delay at all
repeatedly over a period of time
many times, one after another
at every time, on every occasion

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a second hand that never rests, then move to an annoying habit and to a state that lasts all day.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从不休息的秒针开始，再到惹人烦的习惯，最后到持续一整天的状态。

normal.en: Constant plus -ly turns a standing thing into an action that never sits down.
normal.cn: constant 加上 -ly，把站住的东西变成一个从不停下的动作。

normal.en: A dripping tap is the sound of constantly.
normal.cn: 滴水的水龙头就是 constantly 的声音。

normal.en: If a friend says it three times before lunch, it is happening constantly.
normal.cn: 若朋友在午饭前说了三遍，那就是一再地发生。

normal.en: Constant is the state, constantly is the motion.
normal.cn: constant 是状态，constantly 是动作。

normal.en: The clock does not decide to be regular; it just is.
normal.cn: 钟并不决定要规律，它本来就这样。

abstract.en: Picture a second hand sweeping the same circle.
abstract.cn: 想象一根秒针扫过同一个圆圈。

abstract.en: Picture small waves hitting the same stone.
abstract.cn: 想象细小的浪一遍遍拍打同一块石头。

abstract.en: Picture a light left on above a shop door.
abstract.cn: 想象一家店门上方一直亮着的灯。

examples.en: She constantly checks her messages during dinner.
examples.cn: 吃饭时她不停地看消息。

examples.en: The two brothers are constantly arguing.
examples.cn: 这两兄弟老是争吵。

examples.en: Prices have been constantly rising this year.
examples.cn: 今年物价一直在上涨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constantly 记成 constant（恒定的）加 ly：以恒定不变的方式一遍遍发生，就是不断地。

root: 由 constant 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，constant 源自拉丁语 constare（com 一起 + stare 站立），本义是稳稳站住，故 constantly 指不间断地、一再地。

sensesIntro.en: From a process with no pause, to a habit that repeats too often, and to a state that lasts all day.
sensesIntro.cn: 从没有停顿的过程，到重复过多的习惯，最后到持续一整天的状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clock hand that never stops moving.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根从不停下的钟表指针。

branches.en: The first sense is motion with no gap at all.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是毫无间隙的运动。

branches.en: The second sense is repetition frequent enough to irritate.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是频繁到令人烦躁的重复。

branches.en: The third sense is a state held across a whole period.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是贯穿整段时间的状态。

branches.en: Both senses describe something that fills time without a hole.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述填满时间、没有空洞的事物。

branches.en: What happens all the while is often what we later call a habit.
branches.cn: 始终在发生的事，后来常被我们叫作习惯。

intro.en: Constantly is built from the Latin base stant-, standing, plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: constantly 由拉丁语词基 stant-（站立）加副词词尾 -ly 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base also appears in constant, constancy and stable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基也出现在 constant、constancy 与 stable 中。

items.meaning: in a way that never really stops
standing firm without change
the quality of not changing
items.exampleCN: 他的忠贞赢得了她的信任。

items.meaning: changing too easily
items.example: An inconstant wind filled the sails.
items.exampleCN: 一阵忽强忽弱的风鼓起了帆。

items.meaning: the way a body or a mind stands
items.example: He took a firm stance on the issue.
items.exampleCN: 他在这个问题上立场坚定。

items.meaning: able to keep standing
a figure standing still
to hold firmly to a demand
items.example: He insisted on a second chance.

definition_en: to form or make up something, or to establish it officially
core_image: 几块砖被摆成一个明确的形状，成为一堵墙
scene: 老师指着实验台上的几样器材说明用途。These small parts constitute the whole system.
sceneCN: 这里 constitute 指「构成」（第 1 个义项：若干部分组成整体）；句意是这些小部件构成了整个系统。

senses.title: Make up a whole
senses.definition: to form a whole when the parts are taken together
senses.definitionCN: 各部分合起来形成一个整体
senses.example: Ten chapters constitute the whole book.
senses.exampleCN: 十章构成了整本书。
senses.why: A whole is only a name until its parts are counted.
senses.whyCN: 整体在数清部分之前，只是一个名字。

senses.title: Amount to something
senses.definition: to be serious or important enough to count as something
senses.definitionCN: 严重或重要到足以被算作某事
senses.example: Such neglect may constitute a crime.
senses.exampleCN: 这种疏忽可能构成犯罪。
senses.why: Law needs a line where a behaviour becomes a named act.
senses.whyCN: 法律需要一条界线，让某种行为变成有名字的罪行。

senses.title: Set up officially
senses.definition: to establish an official body by formal act
senses.definitionCN: 通过正式程序建立官方机构
senses.example: They constituted a committee to study the case.
senses.exampleCN: 他们设立了一个委员会来研究此案。
senses.why: A group becomes an institution on the day it is written down.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体在被写下来的那天，才成为机构。

intro.en: Constitute comes from Latin constituere, to set up or appoint, built from com-, together, and statuere, to place.
intro.cn: constitute 来自拉丁语 constituere，意为设立或任命，由 com-（一起）与 statuere（放置）构成。

items.en: Statuere meant to set something in place and make it stand.
items.cn: statuere 意为把某物放好并让它立住。

items.en: Constituere meant to set up a body or appoint an officer.
items.cn: constituere 意为设立机构或任命官员。

items.en: The noun constitutio named an arrangement and later a decree.
items.cn: 名词 constitutio 指安排，后来指法令。

items.en: French constituer used the word for founding and composing.
items.cn: 法语 constituer 用它表示创立与组成。

items.en: English constitute meant to establish an official body.
items.cn: 英语 constitute 最初指设立官方机构。

items.en: It now commonly means to make up or amount to something.
items.cn: 如今它常表示构成或等同于某事。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin statu- base, and the meaning group names other verbs for making up a whole.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语 statu- 词基，近义组列出其他表示构成整体的动词。

entries.definition: the basic laws of a state, or the way something is made
one of the parts that make up a whole
to start an official system or organization
to form the parts of a whole
to consist of particular parts
to make something into a shape or body

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from bricks set into one wall, then move to an act heavy enough to count as a crime and to a body written into being.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从砌成一堵墙的砖开始，再到重到足以算作犯罪的行为，最后到被写出来的机构。

normal.en: Con- is together and stitute is set up, so constitute is setting things up into one body.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，stitute 是设立，constitute 就是把东西搭成一个整体。

normal.en: Bricks do not become a wall until they are counted together.
normal.cn: 砖要一起被数清，才变成一堵墙。

normal.en: A small act can constitute a big charge in a court.
normal.cn: 一个小动作，在法庭上可能构成重罪。

normal.en: To constitute a committee is to write a group into being.
normal.cn: 设立一个委员会，就是把一群人写进现实。

normal.en: First the parts, then the name of the whole.
normal.cn: 先有部分，再有整体的名字。

abstract.en: Picture several blocks locked into one clear shape.
abstract.cn: 想象几块积木扣成一个清晰的形状。

abstract.en: Picture a line of names signed under a new rule.
abstract.cn: 想象一条新规下面签着一排名字。

abstract.en: Picture one drop joining others to make a stream.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴水与其他水汇成一条小溪。

examples.en: Women constitute half of the workforce here.
examples.cn: 女性构成了这里劳动力的一半。

examples.en: Driving without lights may constitute an offence.
examples.cn: 不开灯驾驶可能构成违法。

examples.en: The members constituted a new council last spring.
examples.cn: 成员们在去年春天组建了一个新理事会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constitute 记成 con（一起）加 stitute（设立）：把若干部分一起立起来，就成了一个整体，即构成。

root: 源自拉丁语 constituere（com 一起 + statuere 放置），本义是把东西一起立起来，后指构成整体、等同于某事与正式设立。

sensesIntro.en: From parts forming a whole, to an act serious enough to be named, and at last to a body set up by formal words.
sensesIntro.cn: 从部分形成整体，到严重到足以被命名的行为，最后到用正式文字设立的机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bricks set down one by one until a wall stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：砖一块块放好，直到一堵墙立起来。

branches.en: The first sense simply joins parts into one named whole.
branches.cn: 第一个义项只是把部分合成一个有名字的整体。

branches.en: The second sense says an act is heavy enough to be renamed as an offence.
branches.cn: 第二个义项说某行为重到可以被改称为一项罪名。

branches.en: The third sense writes a group into official existence.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一个群体写进正式的建制。

branches.en: Both senses turn separate pieces into something with a legal name.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把分散的片段变成有正式名称的东西。

branches.en: A court and a council both depend on words that constitute.
branches.cn: 法庭与理事会都依靠那些起构成作用的文字。

intro.en: Constitute is built on Latin con-, together, plus statuere, to set in place.
intro.cn: constitute 由拉丁语 con-（一起）与 statuere（放置）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin set base stitut- also appears in constitution, institute and substitute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的放置词基 stitut- 也出现在 constitution、institute 与 substitute 中。

items.meaning: to set parts up into one whole
items.example: These twelve poems constitute the collection.
items.exampleCN: 这十二首诗构成了这本诗集。

items.meaning: the way something is built, or a state's basic law
items.meaningCN: 构成方式，或国家的根本法

items.meaning: relating to the basic law
items.example: The court called the rule constitutional.
items.exampleCN: 法院认定该规定符合宪法。

items.meaning: one part that helps form a whole
items.example: Water is the main constituent of the drink.
items.exampleCN: 水是这种饮料的主要成分。

items.meaning: to set a system in place
items.example: They instituted a new safety rule.
items.exampleCN: 他们设立了一条新的安全规定。

items.meaning: a law set down in writing
a figure set up to stand
to put one thing in place of another
items.meaningCN: 把一物放到另一物的位置
items.example: You can substitute honey for sugar.

definition_en: the basic laws of a country, the way something is made up, or a person's health
core_image: 一本薄薄的册子，写着国家如何运转
scene: 开学第一课，老师讲国家的基本大法。The constitution limits the power of the government.
sceneCN: 这里 constitution 指「宪法」（第 1 个义项：国家的根本大法）；句意是宪法限制政府的权力。

senses.title: The basic law
senses.definition: the set of rules that a country is governed by
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家据以治理的根本规则
senses.example: The constitution protects freedom of speech.
senses.exampleCN: 宪法保护言论自由。
senses.why: A nation needs one page that other pages must obey.
senses.whyCN: 一个国家需要一页让其他各页都必须服从的文字。

senses.title: How something is made
senses.definition: the way the parts of something are put together
senses.definitionCN: 某事物的各个部分拼合的方式
senses.example: Scientists studied the constitution of the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家研究了土壤的构成。
senses.why: To know a thing you must know what holds it together.
senses.whyCN: 要认识一件事物，就得知道是什么把它拢在一起。

senses.title: A person's build
senses.definition: the natural health and strength of a body
senses.definitionCN: 身体天生的健康与强健程度
senses.example: He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.
senses.exampleCN: 他体质强健，很少生病。
senses.why: The same word that builds a state also builds a body.
senses.whyCN: 搭建国家的那同一个词，也用来搭建身体。

intro.en: Constitution comes from Latin constitutio, a setting in order, from constituere, to set up, built on com- and statuere, to place.
intro.cn: constitution 来自拉丁语 constitutio，意为安排、规定，源自 constituere（设立），由 com- 与 statuere（放置）构成。

items.en: Statuere meant to place something so that it stands.
items.cn: statuere 意为把某物放好使它立住。

items.en: Constitutio named the way a thing was ordered and arranged.
items.cn: constitutio 指事物被安排与组织的方式。

items.en: Roman writers used it for an official decree.
items.cn: 罗马作家用它指官方的法令。

items.en: French constitution carried the sense of a settled arrangement.
items.cn: 法语 constitution 带有既定安排的含义。

items.en: English constitution first meant the makeup of body or mind.
items.cn: 英语 constitution 最初指身体或心智的构造。

items.en: It became the standard word for a nation's fundamental law.
items.cn: 它成为指国家根本大法的标准用词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin statu- base, and the meaning group names other words for a founding set of rules.

entries.definition: to make up or formally establish something
a part that helps form a whole
an established organization or custom
a formal document granting rights
a rule that a society must obey
the way parts are arranged together

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from one thin book of rules, then move to the way parts are fitted and to the strength of a body.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一本薄薄的规则册子开始，再到部件拼合的方式，最后到身体的强健。

normal.en: Con- is together and stitute is set up, so a constitution is everything set up together as one order.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，stitute 是设立，constitution 就是被一起立成一套秩序的东西。

normal.en: The nation's rulebook fits into one pocket.
normal.cn: 整个国家的规则手册，能放进一个口袋。

normal.en: The constitution of a soil and of a state use the same word for a reason.
normal.cn: 土壤的构成与国家的宪法用同一个词，是有原因的。

normal.en: A strong constitution keeps a body running without complaint.
normal.cn: 强健的体质让身体不吭声地运转。

normal.en: Ask what it is made of, and you are asking about its constitution.
normal.cn: 问它由什么构成，问的就是它的构成。

abstract.en: Picture a small book placed above all other books.
abstract.cn: 想象一本小书被放在所有其他书上头。

abstract.en: Picture a wall with every brick named in a plan.
abstract.cn: 想象一面墙，每块砖都在图纸上有名字。

abstract.en: Picture a body walking uphill without stopping.
abstract.cn: 想象一个身体走上坡路而不停下。

examples.en: The new constitution was approved by a wide margin.
examples.cn: 新宪法以很大优势获得通过。

examples.en: The constitution of the committee changed last year.
examples.cn: 委员会的构成去年发生了变化。

examples.en: Years of running gave her a tough constitution.
examples.cn: 多年跑步让她有了强健的体质。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constitution 记成 con（一起）加 stitute（设立）加 ion：把一个国家的根本规则一起立起来，就是宪法。

root: 源自拉丁语 constitutio（安排、规定），词根 constituere 由 com（一起）与 statuere（放置）构成，本义是一起立定，后指宪法、构成与体质。

sensesIntro.en: From one book of rules, to the fit of parts inside a thing, and to the build of a living body.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一本规则之书，到事物内部部件的拼合，最后到活人身体的底子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin book that all other rules must answer to.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本薄书，其他一切规则都要向它交代。

branches.en: The first sense is the rulebook that outranks every other rule.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是压过其他一切规则的规则书。

branches.en: The second sense asks how the parts of a thing are arranged.
branches.cn: 第二个义项问的是一件事物的部件如何排布。

branches.en: The third sense applies the same idea to a living body.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同一个想法用到活人身上。

branches.en: Both senses describe a whole held together by an inner order.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述靠内在秩序拢住的整体。

branches.en: A body and a state are both judged by how well they are built.
branches.cn: 身体与国家都要看底子搭得好不好。

intro.en: Constitution is built on Latin con-, together, plus statuere, to place, with the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: constitution 由拉丁语 con-（一起）、statuere（放置）与名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin place base stitut- also appears in constitute, institute and substitute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的放置词基 stitut- 也出现在 constitute、institute 与 substitute 中。

items.meaning: the settled order of a state or a thing
items.meaningCN: 国家或事物既定的秩序
items.example: The constitution was signed in the hall.
items.exampleCN: 宪法在那座大厅里签署。

items.meaning: to set parts up into a whole
relating to the basic law
items.exampleCN: 他们提出了宪法层面的诉求。

items.meaning: in a way that follows the basic law
items.exampleCN: 这一举措在宪法上站得住。

items.meaning: against the basic law
items.example: The court struck down the unconstitutional rule.
items.exampleCN: 法院废除了那条违宪的规定。

items.meaning: a part that builds a whole
items.exampleCN: 每个组成部分各有一票。

items.meaning: to put a system in place
items.exampleCN: 他们设立了一套审查程序。

items.meaning: a rule written into law
items.example: The statute took effect in May.

definition_en: to build something by putting parts together, or to form an idea in the mind
core_image: 工人把钢梁一根根吊起，拼成桥的骨架
scene: 工地上的吊车正把钢梁送到桥墩上。Workers construct the bridge in sections.
sceneCN: 这里 construct 指「建造」（第 1 个义项：把材料拼成建筑物）；句意是工人们分段建造这座桥。

senses.title: Build from parts
senses.definition: to build a physical thing by joining materials together
senses.definitionCN: 把材料连接起来建成实物
senses.example: They plan to construct a new school here.
senses.exampleCN: 他们计划在这里建一所新学校。
senses.why: Nothing large appears at once; it is lifted piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 庞大的东西不会一下出现，而是一块块吊起来。

senses.title: Build in the mind
senses.definition: to form an idea, theory or sentence out of separate parts
senses.definitionCN: 用分散的部分搭出想法、理论或句子
senses.example: She constructed a clear argument from three facts.
senses.exampleCN: 她用三件事实构建了一个清晰的论证。
senses.why: Thought also needs a frame before it can stand.
senses.whyCN: 想法也要先有个架子，才能立起来。

senses.title: Draw by rule
senses.definition: to draw a geometric figure exactly as the rules require
senses.definitionCN: 严格按规则画出几何图形
senses.example: Construct a triangle with these two sides.
senses.exampleCN: 用这两条边作一个三角形。
senses.why: Geometry builds shapes with a ruler and a compass.
senses.whyCN: 几何用尺和圆规把图形搭建出来。

intro.en: Construct comes from Latin construere, to pile up or build, built from com-, together, and struere, to pile.
intro.cn: construct 来自拉丁语 construere，意为堆起或建造，由 com-（一起）与 struere（堆积）构成。

items.en: Struere meant to pile things in layers.
items.cn: struere 意为把东西一层层堆起。

items.en: Construere meant to pile materials into a building.
items.cn: construere 意为把材料堆成一座建筑。

items.en: It also described putting words together in order.
items.cn: 它也描述把词语按顺序组合起来。

items.en: French construire kept both the building and the wording senses.
items.cn: 法语 construire 同时保留建造与组句两层意思。

items.en: English construct meant to build up a structure.
items.cn: 英语 construct 指搭起一座结构。

items.en: It now also covers building an argument or a theory.
items.cn: 如今它也指构建论证或理论。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin pile base struct-, and the meaning group names other verbs for putting a thing together.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语堆积词基 struct-，近义组列出其他表示把事物搭起来的动词。

entries.definition: the process of building something
helpful and intended to improve something
to teach or give an order
to make something by joining parts
to raise a structure into an upright position

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from steel beams lifted into place, then move to an argument built from facts and to a shape drawn by rule.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被吊到位的钢梁开始，再到用事实搭起的论证，最后到按规则画出的图形。

normal.en: Con- is together and struct is pile, so construct is piling pieces into one thing.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，struct 是堆，construct 就是把部件堆成一个东西。

normal.en: A bridge is only a plan until the first beam is hung.
normal.cn: 在第一根梁吊起之前，桥还只是图纸。

normal.en: Sentences are constructed the same way bridges are: part by part.
normal.cn: 句子和桥一样，都是逐件搭起来的。

normal.en: A good argument is built, not shouted.
normal.cn: 好的论证是搭出来的，不是喊出来的。

normal.en: Ask what holds it up, and you will see how it was constructed.
normal.cn: 问它靠什么撑住，你就看出它是怎么建成的。

abstract.en: Picture a crane lowering one long beam.
abstract.cn: 想象一台吊车放下一根长梁。

abstract.en: Picture three blocks stacked into a neat tower.
abstract.cn: 想象三块积木叠成一座整齐的塔。

abstract.en: Picture a compass drawing an exact triangle.
abstract.cn: 想象一把圆规画出一个精确的三角形。

examples.en: Engineers will construct the tunnel in two stages.
examples.cn: 工程师将分两个阶段建造这条隧道。

examples.en: He constructed his answer carefully from the data.
examples.cn: 他依据数据仔细构建了自己的回答。

examples.en: The shelter was constructed of wood and stone.
examples.cn: 这个避难所是用木材和石头建造的。

root: 源自拉丁语 construere（com 一起 + struere 堆积），本义是把材料堆叠起来建成屋宇，后指建造、组句与构想。

sensesIntro.en: From beams lifted into a bridge, to an argument built from facts, and to a triangle drawn with care.
sensesIntro.cn: 从吊成桥梁的钢梁，到用事实搭起的论证，最后到仔细画出的三角形。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: steel beams hanging from a crane, joining one frame.
core.cn: 核心意象：吊车吊着钢梁，合成一副骨架。

branches.en: The first sense is physical joining, beam against beam.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是实体上的连接，梁与梁相接。

branches.en: The second sense builds arguments and sentences from smaller pieces.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用小片段搭出论证与句子。

branches.en: The third sense draws a figure by following fixed rules.
branches.cn: 第三个义项按固定规则画出图形。

branches.en: Both senses need a frame before the whole can stand.
branches.cn: 两个义项都需要先有骨架，整体才能立住。

branches.en: A proof and a drawing both grow step by step.
branches.cn: 证明与作图都是一步一步长出来的。

the act or process of building
helping to build something better
one who builds

definition_en: the process of building something, or the way something is put together
core_image: 围着绿色围栏的工地，塔吊在缓慢转动
scene: 街角的旧楼被围了起来，里面传出敲打声。The new library is still under construction.
sceneCN: 这里 construction 指「建造、施工」（第 1 个义项：把材料建成建筑的过程）；句意是新图书馆仍在施工中。

senses.title: The work of building
senses.definition: the process of putting materials together to make a building
senses.definitionCN: 把材料拼合成建筑的过程
senses.example: The bridge is still under construction.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥仍在施工中。
senses.why: A site is a promise that is not finished yet.
senses.whyCN: 一个工地就是一个还没兑现的承诺。

senses.title: A built thing
senses.definition: a structure that has been built, often a large one
senses.definitionCN: 已经建成的结构物，常指较大的建筑
senses.example: The old construction beside the river was pulled down.
senses.exampleCN: 河边那座旧建筑被拆掉了。
senses.why: Once finished, the work becomes a thing with a shadow.
senses.whyCN: 活儿干完，就变成一个会投下影子的东西。

senses.title: The way parts fit
senses.definition: the arrangement of words or parts inside a whole
senses.definitionCN: 词语或部件在整体内部的排列方式
senses.example: The grammar book explains this construction clearly.
senses.exampleCN: 这本语法书把这个结构讲得很清楚。
senses.why: Sentences are also assembled, and their frames can be named.
senses.whyCN: 句子也是装配起来的，它们的架子也能被命名。

items.en: Constructio named both building work and the fitting of words.
items.cn: constructio 同时指建造工作与词语的搭配。

items.cn: 法语 construction 把这两面保留在一起。

definition_en: to ask someone for advice, or to look something up for information
core_image: 一个人拿着地图，向路边的老人问路
scene: 出发前，他先给当地的朋友打了个电话。You should consult a doctor before taking the pills.
sceneCN: 这里 consult 指「咨询、请教」（第 1 个义项：向人求取意见）；句意是吃药前你应当咨询医生。

senses.title: Ask for advice
senses.definition: to ask a person with knowledge for their opinion
senses.definitionCN: 向有知识的人征询意见
senses.example: Consult a doctor if the pain continues.
senses.exampleCN: 如果疼痛持续，请咨询医生。
senses.why: No one carries every answer, so some answers must be asked for.
senses.whyCN: 没人能带着所有答案，所以有些答案必须去问。

senses.title: Look it up
senses.definition: to search a book or record for information
senses.definitionCN: 在书本或记录中查找信息
senses.example: He consulted the map before setting out.
senses.exampleCN: 出发前他查了地图。
senses.why: A dictionary is advice that has been waiting quietly.
senses.whyCN: 词典是一份安静等候着的意见。

senses.title: Talk it over
senses.definition: to discuss something with others before deciding
senses.definitionCN: 做决定前与他人一起讨论
senses.example: The mayor consulted with local groups.
senses.exampleCN: 市长与当地团体进行了商议。
senses.why: A decision shared before it is made is harder to resent later.
senses.whyCN: 做决定前先商量，日后就不容易招怨。

intro.en: Consult comes from Latin consultare, to take counsel, a frequent form of consulere, to gather and deliberate.
intro.cn: consult 来自拉丁语 consultare，意为商议，是 consulere（聚集商议）的反复形式。

items.en: Consulere meant to gather people to deliberate.
items.cn: consulere 意为召集众人商议。

items.en: It also meant to look after the interests of someone.
items.cn: 它也指照看某人的利益。

items.en: Consultare repeated the act of asking for counsel.
items.cn: consultare 表示反复地征询意见。

items.en: French consulter carried the word into advice and books.
items.cn: 法语 consulter 把这个词带到求教与查书。

items.en: English consult meant to seek advice from a person.
items.cn: 英语 consult 指向人求教。

items.en: It now also covers checking a map, a file or a record.
items.cn: 如今它也指查地图、查档案或查记录。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin counsel base, and the meaning group names other verbs for seeking information or advice.

normal.en: Ask before you act, and you have consulted.
normal.cn: 动手之前先问过，你就已经咨询过了。

normal.en: A dictionary is a quiet consultant on the shelf.
normal.cn: 词典是书架上一位安静的顾问。

normal.en: Two heads talking before one hand moves.
normal.cn: 两只脑袋先商量，一只手再行动。

abstract.en: Picture a finger running down a list of names.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指顺着一列名字往下滑。

abstract.en: Picture a phone held to an ear in a hallway.
abstract.cn: 想象走廊里贴着耳朵的手机。

abstract.en: Picture a book opened flat beside a cold cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊平的书旁边放着一杯凉茶。

examples.en: You had better consult a specialist about the pain.
examples.cn: 关于这处疼痛，你最好咨询专科医生。

examples.en: She consulted the dictionary for the exact meaning.
examples.cn: 她查词典确认准确含义。

examples.en: The committee consulted with parents before changing the rules.
examples.cn: 委员会在修改规定前与家长进行了商议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consult 记成 con（一起）加 sult（聚集）：把懂行的人聚到一起问个明白，就是咨询、请教。

root: 源自拉丁语 consultare（反复商议），本义是聚在一起商量，后指向人请教、查阅资料与共同商议。

sensesIntro.en: From a question put to an expert, to a fact hunted down in a book, and to people sitting together before a decision.
sensesIntro.cn: 从向专家提出的问题，到书里找出的一个事实，最后到决定前坐在一起的众人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone holding a map open, asking a stranger the way.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人摊开地图，向陌生人问路。

branches.en: The first sense is a question handed to someone who knows more.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把问题交给懂得更多的人。

branches.en: The second sense asks a page instead of a person.
branches.cn: 第二个义项问的是一页纸，而不是一个人。

branches.en: The third sense puts several voices around one table.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把几个声音放到同一张桌子旁。

branches.en: Both senses go looking for knowledge outside the self.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是到自己之外去寻找知识。

branches.en: Advice and discussion both end in a better informed choice.
branches.cn: 请教与商议都以更知情的选择收尾。

intro.en: Consultancy is consult plus -ancy, from Latin consultare, to take counsel, a frequent form of consulere.
intro.cn: consultancy 是 consult 加 -ancy，源自拉丁语 consultare（反复商议），是 consulere 的反复形式。

items.en: Consulere meant to gather people for counsel.
items.cn: consulere 意为召集众人商议。

items.en: Consultare repeated the act of asking for advice.
items.cn: consultare 表示反复求取意见。

items.en: The suffix -antia named a state or an activity.
items.cn: 词尾 -antia 表示一种状态或活动。

items.en: English consultant first named a person asked for advice.
items.cn: 英语 consultant 最初指被请教的人。

items.en: Consultancy grew into the name of the advising business itself.
items.cn: consultancy 逐渐成为咨询业本身的名称。

items.en: It now means both a firm and the trade it works in.
items.cn: 如今它既指一家公司，也指这门行业。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the consult- family or a similar ending, and the meaning group names other bodies that sell expert service.
note.cn: 形近组共享 consult- 词族或相似词尾，近义组列出其他出售专业服务的机构。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a client's problem carried into a glass room, then move to advice sold as a service and to an industry built on trust.

normal.en: The same question asked by many firms becomes an industry.

normal.en: A consultancy lives on its next good answer.

examples.cn: 这家咨询公司为城市的交通规划提供建议。

examples.en: She left banking to start her own consultancy.
examples.cn: 她离开银行业，创办了自己的咨询公司。

examples.en: Consultancy work often means long hours and travel.
examples.cn: 咨询工作常常意味着长时间加班和出差。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consultancy 记成 consult（咨询）加 ancy（行业、机构）：专门靠回答别人问题过日子的机构，就是咨询公司。

root: 由 consult（商议、请教）加名词词尾 -ancy 构成，词根为拉丁语 consulere（聚集商议），后指咨询公司与顾问业。

sensesIntro.en: From one firm that answers questions for money, to the whole trade of selling answers.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一家靠回答问题收钱的公司，到整个出售答案的行当。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass room where charts are explained to a client.

branches.en: The first sense is the firm as a place and a name.

branches.en: Clients return when the advice proves true twice.

branches.en: The industry grows wherever decisions are too complex for one head.
branches.cn: 哪里的事复杂到一个脑袋装不下，这个行业就在哪里生长。

definition_en: to use up a resource, to eat or drink something, or to destroy something completely
core_image: 一张嘴把整盘食物吃空，盘子见了底
scene: 夏天的老空调整天开着，电表转得飞快。Big cars consume far more fuel than small ones.
sceneCN: 这里 consume 指「消耗」（第 1 个义项：用掉资源或能量）；句意是大车比小车耗油多得多。

senses.title: Use up a resource
senses.definition: to use up energy, fuel or materials over time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间里用掉能量、燃料或材料
senses.example: Old machines consume too much electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 旧机器耗电太多。
senses.why: A resource is only noticed on the day it runs out.
senses.whyCN: 资源往往在耗尽那天才被人注意。

senses.title: Eat or drink
senses.definition: to eat or drink something until it is gone
senses.definitionCN: 把食物或饮料吃到、喝到不剩
senses.example: The guests consumed every dish on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 客人们把桌上的菜吃得精光。
senses.why: A meal is also a small act of using something up.
senses.whyCN: 一顿饭也是一次小小的用尽。

senses.title: Swallow up completely
senses.definition: to destroy something completely, especially by fire
senses.definitionCN: 彻底毁掉某物，尤指被火吞没
senses.example: The fire consumed the whole warehouse in minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 大火在几分钟内吞没了整座仓库。
senses.why: Fire takes without leaving anything on the plate.
senses.whyCN: 火拿走一切，盘子里什么也不剩。

intro.en: Consume comes from Latin consumere, to use up, built from com-, completely, and sumere, to take up.
intro.cn: consume 来自拉丁语 consumere，意为用尽，由 com-（彻底）与 sumere（拿取）构成。

items.en: Sumere meant to take up or take to oneself.
items.cn: sumere 意为拿起或取为己用。

items.en: Consumere meant to take up completely and so use up.
items.cn: consumere 意为彻底取走，因而用尽。

items.en: It also described fire taking a whole building.
items.cn: 它也描述火吞掉整座建筑。

items.en: French consumer kept the using and the destroying senses.
items.cn: 法语 consumer 同时保留耗用与毁掉两层意思。

items.en: English consume first meant to destroy or use up.
items.cn: 英语 consume 最初指毁掉或用尽。

items.en: It now commonly describes fuel, food and time.
items.cn: 如今它常用来描述燃料、食物与时间。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin take base sum-, and the meaning group names other verbs for using something up.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语拿取词基 sum-，近义组列出其他表示用尽的动词。

normal.en: Fire consumes; dinner consumes; a long meeting consumes your afternoon.
normal.cn: 火在吞噬，晚饭在被吃光，长会也在耗掉你的下午。

normal.en: What is consumed cannot be handed on.
normal.cn: 被消耗掉的东西，无法再交到别人手里。

abstract.cn: 想象一把叉子刮着盘底最后一点酱。

abstract.cn: 想象油表向空位滑落。

abstract.cn: 想象火焰顺着干燥的横梁蔓延。

examples.en: This heater consumes less power than the old one.
examples.cn: 这台取暖器比旧的省电。

definition_en: the act of using up fuel, food, energy or time, or the amount that is used
core_image: 水表数字不断跳动，一格一格往上走
scene: 工厂的用电数字每个季度都在往上爬。Energy consumption rose sharply last winter.

senses.title: The amount used

senses.exampleCN: 换了新发动机后油耗下降了。
senses.why: What cannot be seen can still be counted on a meter.
senses.whyCN: 看不见的东西，也能在表上被数清。

senses.title: Buying and using

senses.whyCN: 经济是一个圆圈，花销让它转起来。

senses.example: In the last century, consumption was often fatal.
senses.exampleCN: 在上个世纪，痨病常常致命。
senses.why: A disease that consumes the body borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 一种把身体耗掉的病，借用了同一个词。

senses.title: Physical touching

senses.whyCN: 笔记本里一个有用的名字，是日后会打开的门。

intro.cn: contact 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tangere（触碰）构成，其分词词基为 tact-。

items.meaning: working without any physical touch

items.meaning: able to be reached

items.meaning: relating to touch

items.meaning: able to be touched or felt

not touched, so whole and undamaged

definition_en: to have something inside, or to keep something under control
core_image: 一只箱子把里面的东西全兜住，一点不外漏
scene: 她打开信封，里面是一张折好的地图。This box contains all the old letters.
sceneCN: 这里 contain 指「装有、包含」（第 1 个义项：内部盛有某物）；句意是这只箱子里装着所有旧信件。

senses.title: Have inside
senses.definition: to have something inside or as a part
senses.definitionCN: 内部盛有某物，或把某物作为一部分
senses.example: The letter contains a short apology.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信里有一句简短的道歉。
senses.why: A shell is interesting mainly for what it keeps.
senses.whyCN: 一个外壳之所以值得一提，主要看它装着什么。

senses.title: Have room for
senses.definition: to be able to hold a certain amount
senses.definitionCN: 能够装下一定的数量
senses.example: This bottle contains two litres.
senses.exampleCN: 这个瓶子能装两升。
senses.why: Every container has a limit it never tells you out loud.
senses.whyCN: 每个容器都有一个它不会开口说的限度。

senses.title: Keep under control
senses.definition: to stop something from spreading or showing
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事物扩散或显露出来
senses.example: Firefighters contained the fire before midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员在午夜前控制住了火势。
senses.why: The same word that holds water can hold back fear.
senses.whyCN: 兜住水的那同一个词，也能兜住恐惧。

intro.en: Contain comes from Latin continere, to hold together, built from com-, together, and tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: contain 来自拉丁语 continere，意为握在一起，由 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold in the hand or keep.
items.cn: tenere 意为握在手中或守住。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together inside.
items.cn: continere 意为把东西拢在里面。

items.en: It also meant to keep feelings or crowds in check.
items.cn: 它也指把情绪或人群约束住。

items.en: French contenir carried the holding sense into use.
items.cn: 法语 contenir 把盛装的含义带入使用。

items.en: English contain first meant to hold within limits.
items.cn: 英语 contain 最初指在界限内盛住。

items.en: It now covers both holding things and holding back danger.
items.cn: 如今它既指盛装物品，也指遏制危险。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin hold base ten-, and the meaning group names other verbs for having something inside.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语握持词基 ten-，近义组列出其他表示内部含有的动词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a closed box, then move to a bottle with a fixed limit and to a fire held inside a line.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只合上的箱子开始，再到一个有固定容量的瓶子，最后到被拦在一条线里的火。

normal.en: Con- is together and tain is hold, so contain is holding things together inside.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tain 是握住，contain 就是把东西拢在里面。

normal.en: A box contains, a bottle contains, a good speaker contains nerves.
normal.cn: 箱子装着东西，瓶子装着水，好的演讲者装着紧张。

normal.en: Contain is a wall; include is a welcome.
normal.cn: contain 是一道墙，include 是一声欢迎。

normal.en: The lid is closed, and the story stays inside.
normal.cn: 盖子合上，故事就留在里面。

normal.en: To contain a fire is to give it nowhere to go.
normal.cn: 控制一场火，就是让它无处可去。

abstract.en: Picture a closed tin on a high shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象高处架子上的一只合上的铁盒。

abstract.en: Picture a jar filled exactly to the line.
abstract.cn: 想象一只刚好装到刻线的罐子。

abstract.en: Picture a rope line stopping a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳线拦住人群。

examples.en: The report contains several useful charts.
examples.cn: 这份报告里有几张有用的图表。

examples.en: This drink contains no sugar at all.
examples.cn: 这种饮料完全不含糖。

examples.en: Doctors worked fast to contain the infection.
examples.cn: 医生迅速行动以控制感染。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contain 记成 con（一起）加 tain（握住）：把东西一起握在壳里，就是包含、容纳。

root: 源自拉丁语 continere（com 一起 + tenere 握住），本义是把东西拢在一起，后指包含、容纳与把危险或情绪控制住。

sensesIntro.en: From what a box keeps inside, to the amount a bottle can hold, and to a fire stopped at a line.
sensesIntro.cn: 从箱子里装着的东西，到瓶子能装的量，最后到被拦在一条线上的火。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a closed box with everything held inside its walls.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只合上的箱子，东西都被兜在四壁之内。

branches.en: The first sense is simply what the walls enclose.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是四壁围住的东西。

branches.en: The second sense is the size of the space inside.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是内部空间的大小。

branches.en: The third sense keeps something from getting out.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是让某物跑不出去。

branches.en: Both senses are about an inside that has a limit.
branches.cn: 两个义项都关于一个有界限的内部。

branches.en: A space with limits can also limit a danger.
branches.cn: 有界限的空间，也能限制危险。

intro.en: Contain is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: contain 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin hold base ten-/tain- also appears in maintain, obtain and retain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的握持词基 ten-/tain- 也出现在 maintain、obtain 与 retain 中。

items.meaning: to hold something inside
a thing made to hold other things
items.example: Put the rice in a container.

items.meaning: the act of keeping something in
items.meaningCN: 把某物限制在内的行为
items.example: The containment of the leak took hours.
items.exampleCN: 控制泄漏花了几个小时。

items.meaning: able to be kept under control
to keep holding in good state
items.meaningCN: 持续握住并保持良好状态
items.exampleCN: 他们把这条路养护得很好。

items.meaning: to get hold of something

items.exampleCN: 她拿到了文件的一份副本。

items.meaning: to keep holding something back
to hold someone back

definition_en: a box, bottle or other object made to hold things
core_image: 码头上一排巨大的彩色集装箱
scene: 码头上，吊机把一只铁箱从船上吊到卡车。The container was loaded with clothes.
sceneCN: 这里 container 指「集装箱」（第 2 个义项：运输货物用的大铁箱）；句意是这只集装箱装满了衣服。

senses.title: A holder for things
senses.definition: a box, jar or bottle used to hold food or objects
senses.definitionCN: 用来盛放食物或物品的盒、罐或瓶
senses.example: Keep the flour in a dry container.
senses.exampleCN: 把面粉放在干燥的容器里。
senses.why: Small loose things need one shell to become a load.
senses.whyCN: 零散的小东西需要一个外壳，才能变成一批货。

senses.title: A giant steel box
senses.definition: a very large metal box used for moving goods by ship or train
senses.definitionCN: 用船或火车运送货物的大型金属箱
senses.example: The container left the port at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 那只集装箱在黎明时驶离港口。
senses.why: Standard sizes turned loading into a game of blocks.
senses.whyCN: 统一的尺寸，把装货变成了一场积木游戏。

intro.en: Container is contain plus the thing ending -er, from Latin continere, to hold together.
intro.cn: container 是 contain 加表物的词尾 -er，源自拉丁语 continere（握在一起）。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold, and continere meant to hold together.
items.cn: tenere 意为握住，continere 意为拢在一起。

items.en: The idea named both a space and what it kept.
items.cn: 这一概念同时指空间与空间所盛之物。

items.en: French contenir supplied the verb behind the English noun.
items.cn: 法语 contenir 提供了英语名词背后的动词。

items.en: English container first meant any vessel or holder.
items.cn: 英语 container 最初指任何盛器。

items.en: World trade gave the word its huge steel-box sense.
items.cn: 世界贸易赋予它大型钢制货箱的含义。

items.en: It now means both a kitchen jar and a cargo box.
items.cn: 如今它既指厨房的罐子，也指货运的箱子。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contain- family, and the meaning group names other things made to hold something.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contain- 词族，近义组列出其他用来盛物的东西。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a jar on a kitchen shelf, then move to a tall stack of steel boxes at a port.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从厨房架上的一只罐子开始，再到港口高高堆起的钢箱。

normal.en: Contain plus -er means the thing that does the holding.
normal.cn: contain 加 -er，就是负责盛住东西的那个物件。

normal.en: A jar, a bottle and a steel box all do the same job at different sizes.
normal.cn: 罐子、瓶子和钢箱只是尺寸不同，干的却是同一件事。

normal.en: Kitchens have containers; ports have containers; the word travels well.
normal.cn: 厨房有容器，港口有集装箱，这个词走得很远。

normal.en: Open the lid and the contents become visible.
normal.cn: 打开盖子，里面的东西才看得见。

normal.en: A container is judged by what it keeps dry.
normal.cn: 一个容器好不好，要看它让什么保持干燥。

abstract.en: Picture a row of coloured steel boxes at a port.
abstract.cn: 想象港口一排彩色的钢箱。

abstract.en: Picture a glass jar with a tight metal lid.
abstract.cn: 想象一只带紧金属盖的玻璃罐。

abstract.en: Picture a crane setting one box on another.
abstract.cn: 想象吊机把一只箱子放到另一只上。

examples.en: She stored the rice in a sealed container.
examples.cn: 她把米存放在密封容器里。

examples.en: The container ship docked before noon.
examples.cn: 那艘集装箱船在正午前靠港。

examples.en: Each container holds about twenty tons.
examples.cn: 每只集装箱能装大约二十吨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 container 记成 contain（容纳）加 er（物）：专门用来容纳东西的物件，就是容器，放大到货运就是集装箱。

root: 由 contain（容纳）加表物词尾 -er 构成，词根为拉丁语 continere（com 一起 + tenere 握住），后指各类容器与货运集装箱。

sensesIntro.en: From the jar that keeps flour dry, to the steel box that crosses an ocean.
sensesIntro.cn: 从让面粉保持干燥的罐子，到跨越大洋的钢箱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of tall steel boxes stacked at a port.
core.cn: 核心意象：港口堆着一排高大的钢箱。

branches.en: The first sense is any small shell for daily things.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是日常物品的任意小外壳。

branches.en: The second sense is that same idea grown to ship size.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是同一想法长到轮船的尺寸。

branches.en: Both senses protect what is inside from the outside.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保护里面不受外面影响。

branches.en: A good lid matters as much as a good box.
branches.cn: 好盖子与好箱子一样重要。

branches.en: One standard size lets ships, trains and trucks share a load.
branches.cn: 一种标准尺寸，让船、火车与卡车共用一批货。

definition_zh: 当代的；同时代的；同时代的人
definition_en: belonging to the present time, or existing at the same time as something else
core_image: 一间摆着现代家具和旧木梁的屋子，两个时代并排
scene: 美术馆的一层正在展出当下艺术家的作品。The museum has a whole floor of contemporary art.
sceneCN: 这里 contemporary 指「当代的」（第 1 个义项：属于当下这个时代）；句意是这家美术馆有整整一层当代艺术。

senses.title: Of the present age
senses.definition: belonging to the time we live in now
senses.definitionCN: 属于我们现在生活的这个时代
senses.example: She collects contemporary paintings.
senses.exampleCN: 她收藏当代绘画。
senses.why: Every age calls itself the present, and means it.
senses.whyCN: 每个时代都把自己叫作当下，而且说得很真诚。

senses.title: Of the same time
senses.definition: existing or happening in the same period as something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物存在于同一个时期
senses.example: These two buildings are contemporary with each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两座建筑属于同一时代。
senses.why: Two things can share a century without ever meeting.
senses.whyCN: 两件事可以共处一个世纪，却从未相遇。

senses.title: A person of the same age
senses.definition: a person who lived or worked at the same time as another
senses.definitionCN: 与另一人同时生活或工作的人
senses.example: He was a contemporary of the young Mozart.
senses.exampleCN: 他是青年莫扎特的同时代人。
senses.why: History is easier to see beside someone who stood next to it.
senses.whyCN: 历史若挨着一个曾站在旁边的人来看，会清楚些。

intro.en: Contemporary comes from Latin contemporarius, built from com-, together, and tempus, time.
intro.cn: contemporary 来自拉丁语 contemporarius，由 com-（一起）与 tempus（时间）构成。

items.en: Tempus meant time or a period of time.
items.cn: tempus 意为时间或一段时期。

items.en: Contemporarius meant sharing the same time.
items.cn: contemporarius 意为共处同一时间。

items.en: It described events and people of one period.
items.cn: 它用来描述同一时期的事件与人物。

items.en: French contemporain carried both the present and the same-time senses.
items.cn: 法语 contemporain 同时带有当下与同时两层意思。

items.en: English contemporary first meant living at the same time.
items.cn: 英语 contemporary 最初指生活在同一时期。

items.en: It now usually points to art and culture of our own day.
items.cn: 如今它通常指我们这一天的艺术与文化。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin time base tempor-, and the meaning group names other words for what belongs to now.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语时间词基 tempor-，近义组列出其他表示「属于现在」的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a room where new chairs stand under old beams, then move to two lives sharing one century.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从新椅子摆在旧木梁下的房间开始，再到共享一个世纪的两个人。

normal.en: Con- is together and tempor is time, so contemporary is sharing one time.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tempor 是时间，contemporary 就是共处同一时间。

normal.en: Contemporary art is the art of the room you are standing in.
normal.cn: 当代艺术，就是你此刻站着的那间屋子里的艺术。

normal.en: Two painters of one year are contemporaries, even if they never met.
normal.cn: 同一年份的两位画家就是同时代人，哪怕从未见过。

normal.en: Temporary lasts a while; contemporary means this while.
normal.cn: temporary 是持续一阵子，contemporary 指的是眼下这一阵。

normal.en: Every era thinks it is the final one.
normal.cn: 每个时代都以为自己是最后一个。

abstract.en: Picture old wooden beams above a clean new table.
abstract.cn: 想象旧木梁下面一张干净的新桌子。

abstract.en: Picture two calendars hanging side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象两本日历并排挂着。

abstract.en: Picture a gallery wall lit by a single lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象画廊的一面墙被一盏灯照亮。

examples.en: The gallery shows contemporary Chinese painting.
examples.cn: 这家画廊展出中国当代绘画。

examples.en: The poet was a contemporary of Shakespeare.
examples.cn: 这位诗人是莎士比亚的同时代人。

examples.en: Contemporary life moves faster than it did a century ago.
examples.cn: 当代生活比一个世纪前快得多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contemporary 记成 con（一起）加 tempor（时间）加 ary：和你共享同一段时间的，就是同时代的、当代的。

root: 源自拉丁语 contemporarius（com 一起 + tempus 时间），本义是共处同一时间，后指当代的、同时代的与同时代的人。

sensesIntro.en: From the art of our own day, to two lives in one century, and to the person who stood beside a famous name.
sensesIntro.cn: 从我们这一天的艺术，到同一个世纪里的两段人生，最后到站在名人身边的那个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a modern chair standing under an old timber beam.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把现代椅子立在旧木梁之下。

branches.en: The first sense points at the culture being made right now.
branches.cn: 第一个义项指向此刻正在被创造的文化。

branches.en: The second sense lines two things up in one period.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把两件事排进同一个时期。

branches.en: The third sense turns the period into a person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一段时期变成一个人。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a clock everyone agrees about.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个人人都认的时钟。

branches.en: A contemporary is a witness who happened to share the years.
branches.cn: 同时代人就是一个恰好共享那些年份的见证者。

intro.en: Contemporary is built on Latin com-, together, plus tempus, time, with the ending -ary.
intro.cn: contemporary 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、tempus（时间）与词尾 -ary 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin time base tempor- also appears in temporary, tempo and temporal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的时间词基 tempor- 也出现在 temporary、tempo 与 temporal 中。

senses.title: The amount inside
senses.definition: the amount of a substance held in something
senses.definitionCN: 某物内部所含某种物质的量
senses.example: Check the sugar content on the label.
senses.exampleCN: 看看标签上的含糖量。
senses.why: What a thing is made of can be printed as a number.
senses.whyCN: 一件东西由什么构成，能印成一个数字。

senses.title: Quietly satisfied
senses.definition: happy with what one has and not wanting more
senses.definitionCN: 对已有的事物满意而不求更多
senses.example: She felt content with her small garden.
senses.exampleCN: 她对自己那片小花园感到满足。
senses.why: The word that means held together also means at rest.
senses.whyCN: 表示「拢在一起」的那个词，也表示安心。

intro.en: Content comes from Latin contentus, the past participle of continere, held together, and so also satisfied.
intro.cn: content 来自拉丁语 contentus，是 continere（拢住）的过去分词，因而也含有「被满足」之意。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together inside.
items.cn: continere 意为把东西拢在里面。

items.en: Contentus described something contained, and later a mind at rest.
items.cn: contentus 描述被容纳之物，后来也指安定的心。

items.en: The noun named what a thing held within it.
items.cn: 相应的名词指事物内部所盛的东西。

items.en: French content kept both the inside and the satisfied senses.
items.cn: 法语 content 同时保留内部与满足两层意思。

items.en: English content first meant what a writing held.
items.cn: 英语 content 最初指文字作品所包含的东西。

items.en: It now covers media material and the amount of a substance.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖媒体素材与某种物质的含量。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contain- family, and the meaning group names other words for what fills a thing or a mind.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contain- 词族，近义组列出其他表示充盈之物或满足之情的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a page full of print, then move to a number on a label and to a person who wants nothing more.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从印满字的书页开始，再到标签上的一个数字，最后到一个别无所求的人。

normal.en: Content is what a container holds, moved from things to words.
normal.cn: content 就是容器里的东西，从实物挪到了文字上。

normal.en: A thick cover hides a thin content, or a rich one.
normal.cn: 厚封面既可能盖着单薄的内容，也可能盖着丰富的内涵。

normal.en: Sugar content is content you can measure in grams.
normal.cn: 含糖量是能用克称出来的内容。

normal.en: To be content is to have enough and stop counting.
normal.cn: 满足就是觉得够了，不再往下数。

normal.en: The same word fills a book and calms a heart.
normal.cn: 同一个词既装满一本书，也安顿一颗心。

abstract.en: Picture an open book with dense small print.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊开的书，满是细密的字。

abstract.en: Picture a label with one number circled.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签上有一个被圈出的数字。

abstract.en: Picture a person sitting still with a cup of tea.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人端着一杯茶静静坐着。

examples.en: The content of the course is mostly practical.
examples.cn: 这门课的内容大多是实用的。

examples.en: This juice has a high sugar content.
examples.cn: 这种果汁含糖量很高。

examples.en: He was content to wait another hour.
examples.cn: 他愿意再等一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 content 记成 con（一起）加 tent（握住）：被一起握住、兜在里面的东西就是内容，兜得刚好就叫满足。

root: 源自拉丁语 contentus（continere 拢住 的过去分词），本义是被盛住、被围住，后指容器里的内容、物质的含量，又引申为内心安定的满足。

sensesIntro.en: From the words held inside a cover, to the grams held in a bottle, and to a heart that holds enough.
sensesIntro.cn: 从封面里装着的文字，到瓶子里装着的克数，最后到一颗装得下「够了」的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open book whose pages are packed with print.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本摊开的书，书页上排满文字。

branches.en: The first sense is everything the cover keeps from view.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是封面挡在视线之外的一切。

branches.en: The second sense weighs the inside in grams.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用克来称里面的东西。

branches.en: The third sense says a person can also be full and at rest.
branches.cn: 第三个义项说人也能装满而安歇。

branches.en: Both senses ask what a thing is carrying inside it.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在问一件东西里面装着什么。

branches.en: Enough sugar and enough peace are both a kind of measure.
branches.cn: 足够的糖与足够的安宁，都是一种度量。

intro.en: Content is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold: what is held inside.
intro.cn: content 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成，指被拢在里面的东西。

latinIntro.en: The Latin hold base tent- also appears in contain, retention and maintain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的握持词基 tent- 也出现在 contain、retention 与 maintain 中。

items.meaning: what is held inside something
items.meaningCN: 被拢在某物里面的东西
items.example: The content of the box was a mystery.
items.exampleCN: 盒子里装的是什么仍是个谜。

items.meaning: the list or the things inside
items.example: She checked the contents of the bag.

items.meaning: feeling quiet satisfaction
items.example: The cat looked contented by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 那只猫在炉火边显得很满足。

items.meaning: the state of wanting nothing more
items.example: A simple meal gave him contentment.
items.exampleCN: 一顿简单的饭就让他很知足。

items.meaning: in a satisfied way
to hold something inside
an object that holds other things
to keep something going well
